mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported pickup: traditional_loot: menu_loot(menu_on_request, put_in)

summary: The v57 traditional-style container case reaches the requested take-out item menu and stops because js/pickup.js:traditional_loot refuses the source-supported menu_on_request path. pickup.c:traditional_loot passes the negative retry value to menu_loot; the JavaScript menu_loot implementation already handles retry -2 and can provide the requested item list.

source.branch: In menustyle:traditional, the hero enters #loot for a container holding more than one object class, chooses take out, and enters m at query_classes. When itemcount is nonzero, query_classes sets menu_on_request to -2; traditional_loot must call menu_loot(-2, put_in) and turn a positive selected-item count into ECMD_TIME.
callers: pickup.c:use_container calls traditional_loot(FALSE) for take-out, traditional_loot(TRUE) for put-in, and traditional_loot(FALSE) for take-out during reversed looting.

js/pickup.js:use_container calls traditional_loot(false/true) in the matching take-out, put-in, and reversed branches; js/pickup.js:traditional_loot already calls query_classes and menu_loot is implemented in the same module.
dependencies: pickup.c:query_classes returns menu_on_request -2 after an m request with a nonempty object list; its JavaScript port already returns the same field.
pickup.c:menu_loot handles retry -2 as selecting all categories; js/pickup.js:menu_loot maps this to ALL_TYPES_SELECTED and already renders the manual query_objlist item menu.
pickup.c:askchain handles the non-menu class path; the existing JavaScript askchain implementation remains the traditional class-selection caller.

evidence: The saved v57 admission evaluation reports 195/196 screens and cursors with 2300/2300 RNG calls; the manifest and recording hashes match the queue entry.

Fresh diagnostic at 21c8bd543a08958badec3b96cc22b894fbb365ec stops at input step 195 while #loot is rendering the Take out what? item menu. The stop is UnsupportedPickupError at js/pickup.js:traditional_loot; all preceding RNG values match.

pickup.c:query_classes (140-261) sets menu_on_request=-2 for m when the selected container list has items; pickup.c:traditional_loot (3230-3261) passes that retry to menu_loot and uses its positive return as ECMD_TIME.

js/pickup.js:query_classes already sets -2, and js/pickup.js:menu_loot already implements the retry -2 all-categories branch and manual query_objlist path. The only missing behavior in the selected function is the source call/result handling currently represented by UnsupportedPickupError.
